about_the_game:
About the Game

This is a first-person survival horror game.

Core Gameplay

Use items to solve puzzles and progressively find an escape route. While searching for the exit, you cannot attack monsters—only avoid them.

Game Story

The protagonist is an investigator who has been looking into multiple "missing persons cases" in recent years. As the investigation deepens, the protagonist discovers that these incidents are linked to an unknown organization. After piecing together the evidence, all clues point to an abandoned dungeon. Determined to uncover the truth, the protagonist decides to venture into the dungeon alone. Upon entering, the protagonist stumbles upon a major disaster. During the exploration, an unknown life form is encountered, posing a serious threat. To survive, the protagonist must press forward despite the danger.

About Localization

Due to limited personal translation capabilities, if you encounter any localization errors in the game, please contact the developer via email.

Customizable Game Difficulty

You can adjust the game's difficulty according to your preferences.

About Minimum System Requirements

As I am unsure about the exact minimum specifications, I can only provide the configuration of my personal computer used during development as a reference. Throughout the development process, I have strived to optimize the game's scenes.

Warning

《Horror Dungeon》contains intense violence, blood, and gore.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains horror, as well as bloody and violent content.

short_description: 《Horror Dungeon》 is a first-person survival horror game developed by an indie developer. In this game, you play as an investigator sent to survey an unknown location. During the investigation, you become trapped and must explore the area, find tools, and gradually locate the exit to escape.
